title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (52 file(s) differ, 70 missing, 11 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 52 file(s) differ, 70 missing, 11 only in the copy.

- differ: .github/workflows/bootstrap.yml, README.md, agents/AGENTS.md, agents/roles/marketing-manager.md, analytics/analytics.js, autonomy/goals.json, autonomy/retention.json, bootstrap/bootstrap.py, docs/claims.json, scripts/balance.py, scripts/claims.py, standards/surfaces.json ...
- missing: .github/workflows/improve.yml, .github/workflows/platform-sync.yml, autonomy-kit/autonomy.workflow.yml, autonomy/balance.json, autonomy/improve.json, autonomy/kit.json, autonomy/seed-lifecycle.json, autonomy/yearsim.json, doctrine/readmes.json, scripts/check_readmes.py, scripts/improve.py, scripts/resolve_generated.py ...
- extra: .github/workflows/balance.yml, .github/workflows/branch-cleanup.yml, doctrine/balance.json, doctrine/verification.json, scripts/branch_cleanup.py, scripts/verify.py, scripts/verify_spend.mjs, tests/test_balance.py, tests/test_verify.py, worker/src/stepplan.js, worker/test/stepplan.test.js

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
